info.title: Fenergo Nebula Localisation Query
info.description:
**Localisation Query API**:
Localisation Query API retrieves localisations and aggregates.
**Localisation Query API provides**:
  • The ability to query for Localisations.
  • The ability to query for a Localisation Instance. That includes searching by Localisation ID.

get.summary: Get all Localisations for the client tenant without Context data.
get.description:
This method returns all Localisations for given tenant
